items.title: Adding a dependency without its own dependencies  like `--no-deps` in pip
items.reason: A comment independently shows the identical empty PEP 508 input and detached caret, but astral-sh/uv#11215 tracks dependency-metadata and `--no-deps` semantics rather than diagnostic formatting.

items.title: Use UTF-8 lengths for requirement errors
items.reason: astral-sh/uv#19781 is adjacent fix-oriented precedent for the same PEP 508 error renderer: it corrected multibyte span rendering, but did not address zero-length input.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged pull requests using the exact error, `orphaned caret`, `points nowhere`, TOML parse error/caret combinations, empty or blank dependency and requirement terms, PEP 508 diagnostic, span, underline, and formatting terms, and astral-sh/uv#21089. Comments, references, recent parser commits, and formatter fixes were inspected. The only prior exact output was incidental to astral-sh/uv#11215. Plausible candidates astral-sh/uv#13183 and astral-sh/uv#8281 with astral-sh/uv#8282 were ruled out because they concern a setuptools configuration error and a leading-whitespace parser panic, respectively.

type_reason: Repository source confirms that empty input receives a one-character span and the formatter always emits its underline, producing a caret beneath no text. Rejecting the empty requirement is correct, but this user-facing rendering is misleading. No existing issue or pull request canonically tracks the formatting problem, and no prior fix has regressed.
summary: astral-sh/uv#11215 incidentally demonstrates the same artifact, while astral-sh/uv#19781 fixed a different PEP 508 span-rendering bug. Neither tracks or fixes the empty-input case.
draft_response: Thanks for the clear reproduction. The empty string is invalid and uv is correct to reject it, but the standalone caret is not useful. The PEP 508 formatter currently forces a one-character underline even when the input is empty, which produces this detached caret inside the TOML diagnostic. This is a diagnostic-formatting bug. A fix should suppress the empty inner source and underline while retaining the TOML span and PEP 508 message, with regression coverage for inline script dependencies.
